file_commits.subject: upgrade_test: wait for post-raft procedures in remaining upgrade tests Apply the 2026.1+ topology-upgrade handling to the remaining upgrade tests that can continue immediately after `enable_raft_topology()`. These tests now detect whether raft topology is already enabled and, when upgrading into post-raft procedures, wait for schema-on-raft completion and service levels v2 before continuing. This avoids racing test operations with the cluster's topology transition after pre-raft topology removal.
